# Callrack

> Callrack is a pay-per-use information infrastructure platform. Every capability on the API answers HTTP 402
> with x402 payment requirements; pay the advertised amount in USDC on Algorand and the response is yours.
> No accounts, no API keys, no subscriptions.

This is the brand/marketing site. The API, including the current, live list of paid capabilities, their exact
prices, and the OpenAPI contract, is served from a separate origin and generated directly from Callrack's
capability registry, so it never goes stale:

## API
- Live capability list + prices: https://api.callrack.xyz/llms.txt
- OpenAPI: https://api.callrack.xyz/openapi.json
- Agent operating instructions: https://api.callrack.xyz/agents.md

## Paying
- Protocol: x402 (v2), settled by https://facilitator.goplausible.xyz
- Network: Algorand · Asset: USDC
- On HTTP 402, read the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header for the exact, current price; never assume one.
